prompt: A sunny day at a busy apiary. Several white wooden beehives are arranged in a row, with bees flying around. A beekeeper's suit with its veil hangs on a wooden fence post. On a small table, a metal smoker sits next to a hive tool and a bee brush. A large honey extractor stands nearby, with a bucket underneath to catch drips. A clear glass jar of honey gleams in the sun. A honeycomb frame, full of honey, is being inspected. A wheelbarrow is in the background, containing a queen excluder and an uncapping knife. A feeder is placed on one of the hives. The area is for beekeeping, not general gardening, so you will not see a scarecrow or a birdhouse. It is also not a place for leisure, so there is no lawn chair or tiki torch present. The focus is on honeybees, so there is an absence of any hornet's nest, and no one is using a butterfly net.
